about_the_game:
Immerse your clients in a life-size sketch with the Sketch House Pack! Unlock an exclusive architect’s office and transform your interiors with 30 items designed to create striking 2D trompe-l’œil effects.

This DLC includes:
• A new and exclusive architect’s office look for designing your mock-ups
• A wallpaper, floor covering and door
• Exclusive kitchen and living room items: table, chair, sofa, coffee table, cooker, sink, kitchen units, storage and more
• Exclusive bedroom and office items: double bed, desk and desk chair, bedside table, waste bin etc.
• A wide range of exclusive decorative items: large wall clock, ceiling light, cushion, radio, globe, plants, mirrors and wall decorations

Each item’s colour can be customised using the colour wheel.
